title: Thai Vegetable Paella
description: A fusion of Thai and Spanish flavors, this vegetable paella is a vibrant and healthy meal option. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add bell peppers and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Add rice and stir to coat with curry mixture.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Stir in cilantro and serve hot.
Optional: Add protein of your choice, such as tofu or tempeh, for extra nutrition.
